verdict.rationale: The evidence implies a first-party programmatic library but never names it as an SDK. The scraping docs show Python code (a Pydantic BaseModel schema), sessions can be controlled programmatically, and the GitHub repo describes combining AI agents with traditional scripting. Missing for 10: an explicitly named official SDK, language coverage (e.g., Python and TypeScript), install and reference docs, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
